messages:
lexi-sales: Quick ask  Prospect (CedarMed) wants a 1-week POC: sustain 300 qps, p95 <350ms, p99 <700ms, coldstart + CMK for embeddings. Need runbook + two pricing points.
hugo-eng: Sequence stats?
lexi-sales: Sent traces: avg 200 in / 120 out, ~70% session reuse.
hugo-eng: Token rate ~96k tok/s -> ~8 GPUs @12k tok/s each with headroom. Enable KV prefix cache and batching cap=20ms.
mira-ops: I'll draft runbook: 30m steady @300 qps, 10m 3x burst, 5 coldstarts, CMK rotation test at minute 25. Collect p50/p95/p99, tok/s, GPU util, KMS latency.
sam-sre: kms-bot: "CMK STATUS: CMK supported on Dedicated/Private. Hosted uses envelope encryption; for CMK in-path recommend Dedicated in same VPC (latency ~5-10ms)."
anya-qa: I'll build harness and include hosted control for delta. Also test cached-DEK fallback for a 15s KMS outage.
mira-ops: Preliminary ballpark: Dedicated (8 GPUs reserved + infra): "$68k/mo"; Hosted 1mo PoC: "$22k". Marked provisional.
hugo-eng: Include sensitivity table (512 vs 2048 context, 4-bit vs 8-bit) to show GPU reductions.
lexi-sales: Great. Finalize runbook Mon EOD, infra Tue, run Wed-Thu, results Fri. I'll share with CedarMed. Ping here when done. :thumbsup:
